text: The antenna that you use to transmit to the access point will have this radiation pattern, so that the power that is emitted at the physical layer from the node to the access point will be directed. So instead of having an omnidirectional antenna that would spread the power everywhere, this is the omnidirectional antenna. When you do beamforming, you form a beam, right? Beamforming means to form a beam. This is a beam, and you form a beam that is directed toward the access point. And the same when the access point wants to transmit toward this node, it will form a beam that points to this node. If instead the access point wants to transmit toward this other node B, it will form a beam that is directed toward. Okay, so this is in general the concept of beamforming. When transmitters, instead of just transmitting everywhere, they try to direct their power, the transmission power, along a certain direction where.
